about.label: About
about.title: A bit about me
about.subtitle: Developer, problem-solver, and lifelong learner.
about.bio0: I'm a software developer based in San Luis, Argentina, focused on backend, fullstack, and data solutions. I work with Python, FastAPI, SQL, and React to build functional and scalable applications — from REST API design to full-featured frontends with Next.js.
about.bio1: I graduated as a Systems Programmer from the Universidad Nacional de Villa Mercedes and I'm currently pursuing my Systems Engineering degree at the same institution. My academic background gives me a solid foundation in software architecture, data modeling, and systems design.
about.bio2: I have real production experience developing features, debugging, and maintaining platforms in professional environments. I adapt quickly to new technologies and contexts, and I'm driven by solving real problems with clean, well-organized code.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Selected Work
projects.subtitle: Projects built with real technologies, focused on solving concrete problems.

ies.title: Corporate Website — IES Desarrollos Inmobiliarios
ies.description: Corporate website in development for IES Desarrollos Inmobiliarios, a construction company based in Salta, Argentina. Features a multi-slide hero, a projects catalog with dynamic filters by status, slug-based detail pages, a contact form with WhatsApp integration, and Sanity headless CMS for client-managed content. Developed at Dagatek. Will soon replace the current website at iesdesarrollos.com.ar.

saas.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform for Business Management
saas.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform focused on business management for small and medium-sized businesses. Fullstack architecture with a FastAPI backend exposing REST APIs, Next.js frontend with TypeScript, and a PostgreSQL database with tenant-level data isolation. Own commercial product under active development.

autoservicio.title: Self-Service Ordering System
autoservicio.description: Web application for order management in gastronomic establishments. Operates across three interfaces: customer (browsing and placing orders), kitchen (real-time order queue for cooks), and admin (product and user management). Built with Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, and NextAuth.js.

luso.title: Website — Luso Estudio
luso.description: First website for Luso Estudio, an Argentine creative studio focused on branding, social media, web design and audiovisual production. One-page site with an animated hero, a services list with dedicated pages per service, a featured projects gallery, a work-process section and a primary WhatsApp CTA as the conversion channel. Fully static with Next.js, self-hosted brand fonts and lightweight animations. Live at lusoestudio.com.ar.

mobile.title: TuristeAR — Tourism Mobile App
mobile.description: Mobile app to discover tourism, cultural and food experiences across Argentina. Features highlighted activities, search and category filters, detail pages with price, duration, difficulty and direct WhatsApp contact, per-user favorites and an admin panel. Built with React Native, TypeScript, Expo and Supabase.
